name: knowledge-work-plugins
description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
one_liner: A free starter pack of 'job roles' for Claude — install one and your AI assistant suddenly knows how a salesperson, lawyer, or finance analyst actually works, including which tools to check.
buyer: An operations or IT lead at a mid-size company rolling out Claude Cowork who needs the sales, legal, or finance team to get useful results on day one instead of generic chatbot answers.
business_use_cases: A RevOps manager installs the sales plugin so every rep's Claude instance automatically pulls from HubSpot and drafts call-prep notes the same way.
A legal ops team customizes the legal plugin with their own NDA templates and risk thresholds so contract triage follows firm policy instead of generic advice.
An IT consultancy builds a side business configuring and connecting these plugins (wiring up Slack, Jira, Snowflake, etc.) for companies that lack the technical staff to do it themselves.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'Claude Cowork onboarding' as a paid service: connect a client's tools and tune 2-3 of these plugins to their terminology and workflows.
Build and sell industry-specific plugin packs (e.g. a healthcare-compliance flavor of the legal plugin) that extend this free base.

steal_this: Pick one plugin (e.g. customer-support) and ship a done-for-you configured version pre-wired to the three most common tool combos (Zendesk+Slack, Intercom+Notion, etc.) as a paid template.
